newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Terra Mining recommends accepting bid.
newsitem.headline: Terra Mining recommends accepting bid.

text.p: The board of Swedish mining company Terra Mining on Tuesday recommended its shareholders accept Canadian mining company William Resources Inc's takeover bid.

The company partly based its recommendation on a statement from CIBC Wood Gundy plc, which Terra Mining commissioned to evaluate the offer, and on the fact that William Resources has ensured financing, Terra Mining said in a statement.
Terra Mining also saw the price as attractive, the company said.
William Resources launched the bid of 162.50 crowns a share on November 11. The offering was conditional on financing and on that William resources would get at least 90 percent of shares.
But on November 29, William announced that it had ensured financing and withdrew the offer's financing condition.
The offering period expires on December 12, the company said.
Terra Mining shares closed at 160 crowns on Monday.
